title: Kissed with Garlic Mexican Meat Tlayudas
description: A delicious and filling Mexican dish featuring garlic powder, ideal for post-workout meals. Tlayudas are crispy, fatty, and snappy, making them a perfect choice for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Knead the halal ground beef in a large mixing bowl for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Add the chopped onion, garlic powder, cumin, chili powder, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix well.
Divide the meat mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a thin, flat circle.
Heat a large wooden-board over medium heat and cook the tortillas for 30 seconds on each side, until they start to puff up.
Brush the tortillas with lard or vegetable shortening and place a cooked tortilla on a flat surface.
Spread a quarter of the meat mixture onto the tortilla, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top the meat mixture with a quarter of the salsa and a quarter of the shredded cheese.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling and press down gently to seal the tlayuda.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients and cook the tlayudas for 5-7 minutes on each side, until they are crispy and golden brown.
Serve the tlayudas hot and enjoy!
